verdict.rationale: Fellow's homepage says admins can set organization-wide policies for how meetings are accessed, and that users keep control over what they share. That is a first-party but thin claim about sharing governance. Nothing else in the pack documents the specific sharing controls; MCP connection governance and the Super Admin data-export API are separate features and are not credited here. Missing for 10: private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permission settings, admin visibility or reporting of what is shared, and in-depth docs or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared
